title: An Introduction to Kolmogorov Complexity and Its Applications
relevance: Definitive reference on Kolmogorov complexity and its incomputability, compression-based approximations, and connections to randomness; provides the theoretical basis for using compression ratio as a sieve criterion.

title: Computation at the edge of chaos: phase transitions and emergent computation
relevance: Establishes the edge-of-chaos framework for cellular automata, demonstrating that computational capability peaks at intermediate lambda values; directly motivates the Goldilocks-zone hypothesis for Collatz delay.

title: The organization of intrinsic computation: complexity-entropy diagrams and the diversity of natural information processing
relevance: Develops complexity-entropy diagrams showing that maximal statistical complexity occurs at intermediate entropy; provides the formal framework for effective complexity as a sieve criterion.
